scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:extension-host -- --if-supported && esbuild src/workbench.js --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/workbench.js
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:core: npm run build:host && node --test --test-concurrency=1 qa/core.test.cjs qa/extensions.test.cjs qa/extension-packaging.test.cjs qa/extension-registry.test.cjs qa/extension-broker.test.cjs qa/extension-sdk.test.cjs qa/intelligence-provider.test.cjs qa/intelligence-openai.test.cjs qa/intelligence-connections.test.cjs qa/intelligence-context.test.cjs qa/intelligence-patch.test.cjs qa/intelligence-agent.test.cjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 qa/continuum.test.cjs qa/extension-contributions.test.cjs qa/extension-manager.test.cjs qa/extension-sdk-desktop.test.cjs qa/intelligence-mock-desktop.test.cjs qa/intelligence-stream-desktop.test.cjs qa/intelligence-vault-desktop.test.cjs qa/workbench.test.cjs
scripts.benchmark:extensions: npm run build && npm run build:extension-example && node --test qa/extension-benchmark.test.cjs
scripts.test:extension-host: npm run build && node scripts/build-extension-fixture.cjs && npm run build:extension-example && node --test --test-concurrency=1 qa/extension-host.test.cjs qa/extension-runtime.test.cjs qa/extension-sdk-runtime.test.cjs qa/extension-integration.test.cjs
